DECLARE V_CNT NUMBER; BEGIN SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_CNT FROM kii_po_kepquo WHERE QUOTATION_NO = $QUOTATION_NO$ AND QUOTATION_SEQ = $QUOTATION_SEQ$ AND REVISION_NO = $REVISION_NO$ ;
IF V_CNT = 0 THEN INSERT INTO kii_po_kepquo ( QUOTATION_ID ,RECORD_REC ,STATUS ,ADD_DATE ,ADD_TIME ,QUOTATION_NO ,QUOTATION_SEQ ,REVISION_NO ,BUYER_ITEM_NO ,UNIT_MEASURE ,DESCRIPTION ,SPECFICATION ,UNIT_PRICE ,SEND_REMARK ,INTERFACE_FLAG ) VALUES ( 1 ,'D' , $STATUS$ , $ADD_DATE$ , $ADD_TIME$ , $QUOTATION_NO$ , $QUOTATION_SEQ$ , $REVISION_NO$ , $BUYER_ITEM_NO$ , $UNIT_MEASURE$ , $UNIT_PRICE$ , $DESCRIPTION$ , $SPECFICATION$ , $SEND_REMARK$ , 'N' ) ; ELSE UPDATE kii_po_kepquo SET STATUS = $STATUS$ ,ADD_DATE = $ADD_DATE$ ,ADD_TIME = $ADD_TIME$ ,UNIT_MEASURE = $UNIT_MEASURE$ ,UNIT_PRICE = $UNIT_PRICE$ ,SEND_REMARK = $SEND_REMARK$ ,INTERFACE_FLAG = 'N' WHERE QUOTATION_NO = $QUOTATION_NO$ AND QUOTATION_SEQ = $QUOTATION_SEQ$ AND REVISION_NO = $REVISION_NO$ ; END IF; END;
